Q: Formula to self populate Section Column in Excel Table A:

Using a relative named range:

  1. Start by selecting cell A2
  2. On the ribbon, go to Formulas > Define Name
    • Name: CellAbove
    • Refers to: =!A1 (an exclamation point ! with no sheet name and A1 with no $ signs)
  3. In the Section column of your table, use the following formula:
=IF([@Heading]="",IF(ISREF(Table1[#Headers] CellAbove),"",CellAbove),[@Heading])

Additional Notes:

  • The space character between Table1[#Headers] and CellAbove is deliberate. This is the intersection operator, which returns the intersecting cells between 2 range references. If the range references do not intersect, it returns #NULL!. When used in conjunction with ISREF, we can determine if CellAbove is located within the table header row.
  • Replace Table1 with the name of your actual table.
  • If there were no blank row(s) at the top of the table, the formula could be shortened to:
=IF([@Heading]="",CellAbove,[@Heading])
  • By defining a relative named range in this manner, the formula will not break when new rows are added/inserted, or when rows are manually rearranged.

Q: PyTorch training issue with EfficientNetB3 | Validation Accuracy plateu A:

Is the dataset imbalanced? Im pretty sure that is the reason why it is not working (ball park instead of good score). Checkout this article. If this is not the issue then could we get some insight into the data

https://towardsdatascience.com/using-fastai-to-classify-japanese-kanji-characters-47d7edd4d569/

I know you said “class-balanced split dataset from HDF5” but how did you do it? did you upsample the minority classes?

In the article they also use a much deeper neural network (resnet152) and also 128 x 128 is really small (which may lead to dense features). You might want to try a larger size (224 x 224) as those tend to do better for CNNs

Q: Error - Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'get') A:

Check your global variable in main.js which you're trying to use.

Vue 2 format:

Vue.prototype.$http = new HTTPService();

Vue 3 format:

const app = createApp(RootComponent)

app.config.globalProperties.$http = new HTTPService();

Q: SSIS 2005 how to resolve the error "input column has lineage id that was not previously used in the data flow task" programmatically A:

Lineage ID must be invalid

  • Option 1 delete data flow and add again & remap all column

  • Option 2 Open the SSIS package XML Code and search for an invalid Lineage column, copy and paste existing lineage and it should work.

Q: Unable to tunnel through proxy. Proxy returns "HTTP/1.1 407 Proxy Authorization Required" A:

I fixed it by authenticating to the proxy server with my user name and password. If you are on your company's network , it can be your sso cred too. The equivalent of this will be like this : 

-Dhttp.proxyUser=myusername 
-Dhttp.proxyPassword=mypassword
-Dhttp.proxyHost=myproxyserver.com
-Dhttp.proxyPort=9000
